text: The initiative features deep decentralization to 753 municipalities, integration of scientific and indigenous knowledge, inclusive training and e-learning, and community-led mapping at a national scale. It also includes risk-informed policy reforms backed by the Catastrophe Deferred Drawdown Option (Cat DDO) and routine high-level governance via the National Council for Disaster Risk Reduction and Management (NCDRRM).

metadata.solution_name: Nepal’s Government-led Earthquake Risk Reduction and Mitigation Initiatives (2020–2025)
